responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module exposes the C initialization entry points implemented in init.cc to the Modula-2 side of gm2. It declares the one-time frontend initializer and the per-compilation initializer that accepts a filename address, making the startup protocol available across the C/Modula-2 language boundary rather than implementing any initialization logic itself.
same_name_distinction: This is the Modula-2 foreign-definition view of init, declaring FrontEndInit and PerCompilationInit with Modula-2 types such as ADDRESS for use from Modula-2 code. Unlike init.cc it contains no startup logic, and unlike init.h it targets the Modula-2 language boundary rather than C/C++ callers.
